publicBeta.welcome: Welcome to CompassCAD NEXT Public Beta!

segments.body_segment1: Welcome to the CompassCAD NEXT Desktop Public Beta! We're proud that you are here!
segments.body_segment2: Before you can get started, we'd like to warn you of the following things.

warns.doNotDailyDrive: Please do not daily drive this version of CompassCAD yet.
warns.lotsOfBugs: Keep in mind that there will be LOTS OF BUGS, incomplete/unfunctional buttons.
warns.missingFeatures: There will be a LOT of missing features/buttons than desktop/web.
warns.noSettingChange: There are no ways for you to change settings (as of now). If you want to, you'll need to get hacky.
warns.alternative: If you want somewhere to still daily drive, use CompassCAD Desktop (< 2.1.0) or the web.

segments.askForConsent: With that out of the way, let's start by checking "I Consent" and then closing this popup.
segments.checkListConsent: I consent that there will be bugs and I will be responsible for design losses.
segments.riskAccepted: Risk accepted. We won't show you this dialog, but please beware. You're entering dangerous beta territory.
